sources.name: User guide to crime statistics for England and Wales: March 2026
verified_claims: the official guide was last revised on 23 July 2026
police recorded crime covers a wider offence range than the Crime Survey for England and Wales but does not capture all crimes

limitations: recorded-crime counts depend on reporting and police recording and are not a complete census of victimisation
national or force-level methodological evidence cannot be converted into a cardinal parcel safety probability
